comment: A high-speed stream (HSS) from a recurrent positive polarity coronal hole (CH) is anticipated during the first forecast window. Geomagnetic activity up to STORM G1 is possible. From the second period onwards some ACTIVE spells are likely as conditions should slowly start to wane. Elevated solar wind parameters could be sustained into the third interval as we may come under the influence of a second HSS from a northern CH.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
